title: National Broadband Network Companies Amendment (Tasmania) Bill 2014
short_title: National Broadband Network Companies Amendment (Tasmania) Bill 2014

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would require the National Broadband Network company to use fibre to the premises for new fixed line connections it provides in Tasmania.
It would place a fibre-only rule and a minimum connection requirement in the company's governing legislation, expressly excluding technologies that are only partly fibre.
Existing connections would be excluded from the new provisions, which would begin operating on the day after the bill received Royal Assent.
changes: The legislation would gain a new subdivision specifically governing Tasmanian fixed connections.
A partly fibre technology would not satisfy the fibre requirement.
An application provision would protect existing connections from retrospective coverage.
summary.affected: The National Broadband Network company and Tasmanian premises receiving its fixed connections are affected.
